tunings.name: ADPF PerformanceHintManager Session
tunings.mechanism: Creates an Android Dynamic Performance Framework (ADPF) HintSession targeting 16.6ms/8.3ms frame work durations to signal PowerHAL uclamp boost
tunings.validation: Verify returned Session is non-null and preferredUpdateRateNanos > 0

tunings.name: Safe Background Process Memory Trim
tunings.mechanism: Requests ActivityManager to reclaim cached background process memory for non-foreground, non-system packages
tunings.validation: Compare ActivityManager.MemoryInfo.availMem before and after execution
tunings.rollback: Self-healing via Android OS process lifecycle

tunings.name: Android GameManager Performance Mode
tunings.mechanism: Switches target package Game Mode to PERFORMANCE (mode 2) via GameManagerService shell interface
tunings.supported_when: Android 12+ (API 31+) and Shizuku Shell (UID 2000) or Root (UID 0) active
tunings.validation: Read back output of `cmd game mode <package>` and verify mode == 2 (Performance)

tunings.name: Game Mode Frame Rate & Resolution Scaling Intervention
tunings.mechanism: Configures GameManagerService FPS cap and resolution scaling factor (1.0 native or 0.85 sustained thermal)
tunings.validation: Verify via dumpsys game_manager or cmd game status

tunings.name: WindowManager / PowerHAL Fixed Performance Mode
tunings.mechanism: Enables sustained fixed performance mode via PowerManager shell interface for deterministic benchmark runs
tunings.validation: Verify exit code 0 and read-back status

tunings.name: CPUFreq Policy Minimum Frequency Floor
tunings.mechanism: Raises scaling_min_freq on discovered CPUFreq policies to the 75th percentile of scaling_available_frequencies to eliminate frequency ramp latency
tunings.supported_when: Policy node exists under /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy* and UID 0 (Root) write access is available
tunings.validation: Target frequency must exist in scaling_available_frequencies; read back scaling_min_freq after write
tunings.rollback: Write snapshotted baseline scaling_min_freq back to each policy node

tunings.name: CPUFreq Governor Selection (schedutil / performance)
tunings.mechanism: Selects verified scaling governor from scaling_available_governors per CPU cluster
tunings.supported_when: scaling_available_governors is readable and scaling_governor is writable via Root
tunings.validation: Read back scaling_governor and verify exact match

tunings.name: GPU Devfreq Minimum Frequency Floor
tunings.mechanism: Raises GPU devfreq min_freq to a validated OPP step from available_frequencies during active 3D rendering
tunings.supported_when: Discovered GPU node in /sys/class/devfreq/* or /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq with writable min_freq
tunings.validation: Verify target is in available_frequencies and read-back equals target
